question: How many entities have a legal name containing the word 'Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaft'?

PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX lei: <https://www.gleif.org/data/lei/>

question: How many distinct jurisdictions do the direct consolidation subsidiaries of 'Bank of America, National Association' span?
Among ISSUED entities incorporated in Luxembourg, which three legal forms are most common, excluding the placeholder codes 8888 and 9999? Give the legal form name and the count.

attempts.sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX gleif-base: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/Base/>
PREFIX elf: <https://www.gleif.org/data/elf/>
PREFIX jur: <https://www.gleif.org/data/jurisdiction/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?legalFormName (COUNT(?e) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?e a gleif-base:Entity ;
     gleif-L1:hasLegalForm ?lf ;
     gleif-base:hasRegistrationStatus gleif-L1:ISSUED ;
     gleif-base:hasLegalJurisdiction jur:LU .
  FILTER (?lf != elf:8888 && ?lf != elf:9999)
  ?lf rdfs:label ?legalFormName .
}
GROUP BY ?legalFormName
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
LIMIT 3

sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX gleif-base: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/Base/>
PREFIX elf: <https://www.gleif.org/data/elf/>
PREFIX jur: <https://www.gleif.org/data/jurisdiction/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?legalFormName (COUNT(?e) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?e a gleif-base:Entity ;
     gleif-L1:hasLegalForm ?lf ;
     gleif-base:hasRegistrationStatus gleif-L1:ISSUED ;
     gleif-base:hasLegalJurisdiction jur:LU .
  FILTER (?lf != elf:8888 && ?lf != elf:9999)
  ?lf rdfs:label ?legalFormName .
}
GROUP BY ?legalFormName
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
LIMIT 3
